title: Sleepy horse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy horse, head resting, eyes closed -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='68' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='74' rx='28' ry='13' fill='#a86a33'/>
  <!-- mane along neck -->
  <path d='M30 56 Q26 44 34 34 Q40 28 46 30 Q42 38 44 48 Z' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M36 58 Q32 46 40 38 Q48 32 52 40 Q48 50 50 60 Z' fill='#d99a5b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#d99a5b' transform='rotate(-15 38 36)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='42' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f0c9a0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <ellipse cx='19' cy='43' rx='1.8' ry='1.4' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M48 26 Q50 16 55 20 Q53 28 50 30 Z' fill='#d99a5b'/>
  <path d='M49 26 Q50 20 53 22 Q52 27 50 28 Z' fill='#f0a9b0'/>
  <!-- forelock -->
  <path d='M44 26 Q40 22 36 24 Q40 28 42 30 Z' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eye -->
  <path d='M34 33 Q38 37 43 33' stroke='#5a3a1a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyelash -->
  <path d='M33 34 L31 36' stroke='#5a3a1a' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='42' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0a9b0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M64 26 L72 26 L64 34 L72 34' stroke='#9fd8ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 16 L80 16 L74 22 L80 22' stroke='#9fd8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='52' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#a86a33'/>
  <rect x='66' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M84 62 Q92 60 90 70 Q94 78 86 80 Q88 72 84 70 Z' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
</svg>
